# Hamilton Chiropractic

> > Hamilton Chiropractic provides specialized sports and prenatal chiropractic care in San Mateo, CA, led by Dr. Ryan Hamilton and Dr. Elise Hamilton.

The practice offers evidence-based treatments including Graston Technique, Active Release Technique (ART), and Functional Range Conditioning (FRC) for athletes, prenatal patients, and individuals seeking pain management and injury rehabilitation in the Bay Area.

## Key Topics

- Sports Chiropractic
- Prenatal Chiropractic
- Graston Technique
- Active Release Technique (ART)
- Functional Range Conditioning (FRC)
- Soft Tissue Mobilization
- Webster Certified
- Velocity Strength Therapy
- Sports Injury Rehabilitation
- Mobility Therapy
- Chronic Pain Management
- Athlete Performance
- Instrument-Assisted Therapy
- Fascial Treatment
